post.description: Interactive human JWT only; automation keys and self-approval are refused.
Interactive human JWT only; automation keys are refused.

get.description: Enabled, entitled viewers receive connection metadata. Current members with soar:manage may instead list sanitized credential cleanup metadata while SOAR is off or billing entitlement has lapsed; no configuration, credential fields or test results are disclosed.

delete.description: Current members with soar:manage may delete their tenant's stored connection while SOAR is off or billing entitlement has lapsed. Active run references still prevent deletion. This exception does not authorize editing, testing or executing connections.

get.description: Available while SOAR is disabled; missing preference defaults off.

put.description: Human tenant admin only. Enabling also requires the Soar entitlement. Disabling cancels active intents and expires pending approvals; history remains readable.

active_runs.description: Connections with queued/active runs cannot be removed.

oneOf.description:
Capacity refusal keeps events and live schedules pending. Clears after
the next successfully admitted run; distinct from omitted event count.

event_overflow_count.description: Cumulative source events omitted due to queue capacity or payload limits.

executor_pending.description: Legacy intents lacking durable authority are inspectable but cannot send.
